description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Carriage of Dangerous Goods) Regulations No. 08 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, establishing legal requirements for the carriage of dangerous goods. It creates new regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify for government-related classifications (Types 1-3).
